First typeset 2026-10-13.
SUBJECT. Set here: the file name misspells it ("RELIGIUOS", "SYLLBUS").
LEVEL / YEAR. As the cover says. The manuscript prints no year at all; 2026 (user, 13 Nov 2026), as on its companion,
Religious Education Methods. CDC to confirm.
YEAR 2. The matrix is one unbroken table for both years; the YEAR 2 banner goes before topic 2.1 The Role of Religion in
Cross-Cutting Issues (insertRow), where the manuscript's own scope chart starts Year 2.
MATRIX NUMBERS. renumberMatrix: most numbers are Word list numbers that run on across topics (1.4 twice, 1.6.1 twice,
1.6.6 twice, 1.9 twice ...), some typed over them ("2.1.3.4.1" on the Islam competence, "2.4.6.1" on Poverty).
Counted afresh from the table structure. CDC to confirm.
SECOND COVER. After its contents list the manuscript repeats its cover (Republic of Zambia, MINISTRY OF EDUCATION, the
title lines, YEARS 1-2, the crest) and two typed contents lines (REFERENCES ....47, SCOPE AND SEQUENCE CHART ....49); they
printed after the contents and as a full-page crest, and the typed lines ended up at the back of the book. Removed (removeRange).
"CONTENT FOR TWO YEARS" (a heading over nothing but the YEAR 1 page, stranded at the foot of the competences) removed.
CONTENTS. tocGap 6pt: at the default the contents ran one line (Scope and Sequence Chart) onto a page of its own.
TOPIC 1.4. Its cell reads "CHRISTIANITY IN AFRICA" then a stray line "IN" (left from an edit); it set a second topic line and a contents entry "IN". Dropped.

FRONT MATTER (user, 13 Nov 2026: make it standard). The manuscript types its front sections as one numbered list (1. Introduction, 2. RATIONALE ... 6. ASSESSMENT); "Introduction" (mixed case) ran on straight under the Acknowledgements signature, and "5. TEACHING AND LEARNING METHODS" (number typed) sat inside Structure. Now as the other syllabuses set BACKGROUND: INTRODUCTION a section on its own page, RATIONALE, KEY COMPETENCES, STRUCTURE, TEACHING AND LEARNING METHODS and ASSESSMENT sub-headings under it. KEY COMPETENCIES heading + its line -> COMPETENCES as the book spells it elsewhere (15 to 5); PS office dash as on the other syllabuses.
ROUND 1 (reviewer's marked Drive copy, zeph round 1, 14 Nov 2026, 14 comments). It was marked on a print from before the
year 2026 / standard front matter, so #4772-#4774 (2025 -> 2026) and #4776 (Introduction to the next page) were already done.
#4775/#4785 References/Prescribed Reading and the Scope and Sequence Chart deleted, with their contents entries (removeRange to the end).
#4777/#4778 'the four major religious traditions in Zambia' -> 'the four major religions in Zambia' (delete 'traditions', 'religious' ->
'religion'; plural, as the list after it names several).
#4779 Key Competences, Analytical Thinking: the second run of concept growth / types of growth / Hinduism deleted.
#4780 assed -> assessed; #4781 Independence -> Independent churches; #4782 stray 'A' over the ATR standard; #4783 'Of' -> 'of';
#4784 'Use relevant themes' -> 'Use of relevant themes'. editCell patterns: the cells still carry the manuscript's '• ' when they run.
